# vld-tonic

[![crates.io](https://img.shields.io/crates/v/vld-tonic.svg)](https://crates.io/crates/vld-tonic)
[![docs.rs](https://img.shields.io/docsrs/vld-tonic)](https://docs.rs/vld-tonic)

Validate [tonic](https://docs.rs/tonic) gRPC messages and metadata with the [vld](https://crates.io/crates/vld) validation library. Uses only `tonic::{Request, Status}` (tonic 0.12 – 0.14), no transport features.

## Install

```toml
[dependencies]
vld = "0.5"
vld-tonic = "0.5"
```

## Example

```rust
use tonic::{Request, Response, Status};

// Generated by prost.
#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, prost::Message)]
pub struct CreateUserRequest {
    #[prost(string, tag = "1")]
    pub name: String,
    #[prost(string, tag = "2")]
    pub email: String,
}

vld_tonic::impl_validate!(CreateUserRequest {
    name  => vld::string().min(2).max(100),
    email => vld::string().email(),
});

async fn create_user(request: Request<CreateUserRequest>) -> Result<Response<()>, Status> {
    let msg = vld_tonic::validate(request)?; // Status::invalid_argument on failure
    Ok(Response::new(()))
}
```

Metadata is validated with `validate_metadata::<T, _>(&request)` or the `metadata_interceptor::<T>` interceptor.
